hero.name: Aayush Neupane
hero.tagline: I build websites and games from Jhapa, Nepal, and I care about getting the details right, from first sketch to final deploy.

about.bio: I'm Aayush Neupane, an 18-year-old web developer from Nepal. In 2022, I began learning web development and started building projects like chat applications and tracking websites. I enjoy creating digital projects and continuously improving my skills.
about.vision: To grow as a developer and photographer and create projects that people find useful and enjoyable.
